Game Overview

Idle Merge Car and Race is a idle title where merge and race your way to success. Create a car racing empire by combining vehicles, unlocking upgrades, and unleashing turbo mode on the track. Strategize to maximize your earnings and climb the global leaderboard in this addictive idle adventure.

How to Play

Playing Idle Merge Car and Race comes down to a simple loop. Merge and race your way to success! Create a car racing empire by combining vehicles, unlocking upgrades, and unleashing turbo mode on the track. Strategize to maximize your earnings and climb the global leaderboard in this addictive idle adventure.
